181K likes, 8,372 comments - shenaztreasury on May 25, 2026: "A patriotic country is not just about flags and slogans.

It is about respecting the land.

Why does our government not fine people for throwing trash everywhere and spitting???? 

Why are we accepting filth as normal?

Why are rivers full of plastic?

Why are tourists seeing garbage beside mountains, beaches and temples?

Why are we not shaming litterbugs?

Sri Lanka 🇱🇰 — a country tiny compared to India — welcomed around 2.36 million tourists in 2025, and tourism earned them over $3.2 billion. 

And almost every traveler says the same thing after visiting Sri Lanka:

Cleaner streets. Less chaos. Better tourist experience. 
India’s own tourism reports mention that poor hygiene, sanitation and infrastructure are major reasons for lower tourist footfall.".

142K likes, 1,855 comments - shenaztreasury on March 7, 2026: "📌 Waves By Barberyn Welligama 

Happy Women’s Day! 🌹This video is a sign for all the women out there to pause for a moment and take care of yourself.

Your mental health matters. Your physical health matters.

Women spend so much of their lives caregiving… looking after parents, partners, kids, work, everyone else that they forget to take care of themselves.

So this Women’s Day, give yourself permission to do something just for you.

Book a spa day.
Book a massage.
Or go deeper and book an Ayurveda retreat.

This is the one I went to in Weligama, Sri Lanka called Waves By Barberyn Ayurveda Resort.

It is a beautiful Ayurvedic wellness retreat by the ocean where you get doctor consultations, herbal treatments, oil massages, yoga, meditation and personalised Ayurvedic food designed to heal your body and calm your mind. ￼

The entire place is built around medicinal trees and gardens, and the yoga pavilion looks straight out to the Indian Ocean. ￼

I came back feeling lighter, calmer and so much more connected to myself.

So if your body is tired or your mind feels overwhelmed…

take the sign.

Take a break.
Take care of yourself.

Happy Women’s Day ❤️

( WomensDay SelfCare AyurvedaRetreat SriLankaTravel Weligama WellnessTravel AyurvedaHealing SoloWomenTravel )".

6,298 likes, 185 comments - shenaztreasury on October 5, 2026: "Water from air???! What if the air is polluted? ( forgot to ask him that )

Making water from air sounds almost impossible. But Uravu Labs is doing it in India. 💧🇮🇳

The upside is huge. No groundwater extraction. No wastewater or brine. And they can use waste heat from factories and data centres that would otherwise be wasted.

The downside? It still requires energy, it works better in humid conditions, and the materials used to capture moisture need to last and eventually be replaced.

So it’s not impact free. But if powered by waste heat or renewable energy, it could be a fascinating solution to India’s growing water crisis.

Indian innovation, water from air, Uravu Labs, atmospheric water technology, water crisis India, sustainable technology, climate tech, waste heat, Indian startups

India has so many brilliant minds and innovators. We need more ideas like this solving real problems, especially our water crisis.

Share this with a scientist, engineer or innovator. Maybe it sparks another idea.

Indian innovation, water from air, atmospheric water technology, India water crisis, sustainable technology, climate tech, Indian scientists, Indian startups".

3,378 likes, 143 comments - shenaztreasury on September 11, 2026: "Share this with someone who needs to balance their nervous system. Save this and try it today!!! 🌹also pls - Send this to your mother.
Send it to your granny.
Actually, your granny probably needs to send it to YOU. 😂

Your granny knew something your expensive skincare routine doesn’t;) 

OIL YOUR BODY on these areas everyday! 

Ayurveda calls it Abhyanga — the practice of regularly massaging warm oil into your body.

And this isn’t some new wellness trend. Ayurveda has been talking about it for thousands of years.

Special attention to:
Your head. Your ears. Your feet.
And ideally, the rest of your body too.

Ayurveda traditionally associates Abhyanga with better sleep, healthier skin, less fatigue and keeping the body strong as we age.

Basically moisturising, but your dadi style 

A little warm sesame oil. A little massage. Then your bath.

Save this and try adding a little oiling to your daily routine. 🌿".
